sources.headline: Gap Reports Q2 2026 Results: Full Earnings Call Transcript

key_numbers: Q2 net sales -2% vs prior year
fields.observable_in_3_sessions: Old Navy traffic and sales trends, Gap brand momentum, and any updates on tariff relief or consumer spending.
fields.falsifier: A sharp deceleration in Old Navy sales or a broader consumer pullback would undermine the bullish outlook.
fields.already_priced_note: The after-hours move (+11.6%) is larger than the modest positive direction implied by the content, suggesting the market is pricing in more optimism than the fundamentals alone justify.
fields.summary: Management reported Q2 net sales decline of 2% but raised full-year EPS and margin guidance, citing strong gross margin and disciplined execution. They are confident in second-half improvement driven by Old Navy's recovery and Gap's momentum, though Athleta remains challenged.

note: expectation data, not a forecast: what management SAID, read by a model. Compare with what the market priced before stating a thesis.
